Trailing semiconductor nodes are filling at greater rates, leading-edge nodes fully allocated with ~1-year lead times. Dell is 'repricing every day' in the inflationary environment, and customers are signing 3-5 year multiyear supply agreements to secure access. Year-over-year, each server carries MORE cores, MORE DRAM and MORE NAND (content growth on top of unit growth).
